prompt: I mistyped my password several times and was locked out five minutes ago. Should I keep trying?
completion: Wait until 15 minutes have passed before trying again. If the account remains locked after that, contact the IT Service Desk.

prompt: My account locked about ten minutes ago after repeated attempts. What now?
completion: Wait until 15 minutes have passed before trying again. If the account remains locked after that, contact the IT Service Desk.

prompt: I just triggered a temporary account lock. Should I repeatedly retry?
completion: Wait until 15 minutes have passed before trying again. If the account remains locked after that, contact the IT Service Desk.

prompt: Should I include my password in an email to support?
completion: No. Never send or share your university password by email or chat.

prompt: Can I send my password in chat so IT can test my account?
completion: No. Never send or share your university password by email or chat.

prompt: Would sharing my university password make troubleshooting faster?
completion: No. Never send or share your university password by email or chat.

prompt: A friend is visiting campus. Which wireless network should they use?
completion: Visitors should use Campus-Guest rather than Campus-Secure.

prompt: My guest has no university account. Should they use Campus-Secure?
completion: Visitors should use Campus-Guest rather than Campus-Secure.

prompt: Which campus Wi-Fi is intended for visitors?
completion: Visitors should use Campus-Guest rather than Campus-Secure.

prompt: Campus-Secure is visible but rejects authentication. What should I try?
completion: Forget Campus-Secure, restart Wi-Fi, reconnect, and enter your university credentials again. If it still fails while the service is operational, check your account status.

prompt: My laptop sees Campus-Secure but will not authenticate.
completion: Forget Campus-Secure, restart Wi-Fi, reconnect, and enter your university credentials again. If it still fails while the service is operational, check your account status.

prompt: The secure network is visible, yet my login keeps failing.
completion: Forget Campus-Secure, restart Wi-Fi, reconnect, and enter your university credentials again. If it still fails while the service is operational, check your account status.

prompt: I sent a print job 23 hours ago and never released it. Should it still be there?
completion: Unreleased print jobs are kept for up to 24 hours, so a job less than 24 hours old should normally still be available.

prompt: My unreleased print job is less than 24 hours old. Is it normally available?
completion: Unreleased print jobs are kept for up to 24 hours, so a job less than 24 hours old should normally still be available.

prompt: It has been twelve hours since I submitted a print job.
completion: Unreleased print jobs are kept for up to 24 hours, so a job less than 24 hours old should normally still be available.

prompt: My document is queued. How do I get it from the printer?
completion: Authenticate at the printer with your student card to release the queued print job.

prompt: I submitted from a lab computer. What do I do at the printer?
completion: Authenticate at the printer with your student card to release the queued print job.

prompt: How is a queued university print job released?
completion: Authenticate at the printer with your student card to release the queued print job.

prompt: I changed my password and now VPN will not connect. What should I try?
completion: Disconnect the VPN and reconnect using the updated credentials. Confirm normal internet works first.

prompt: VPN stopped authenticating after I updated my password.
completion: Disconnect the VPN and reconnect using the updated credentials. Confirm normal internet works first.

prompt: I changed my university password today and VPN now fails.
completion: Disconnect the VPN and reconnect using the updated credentials. Confirm normal internet works first.

prompt: My laptop has no normal internet. Can VPN connect anyway?
completion: No. A working internet connection is required before the VPN tunnel can be established.

prompt: Wi-Fi itself is offline. Will VPN restore my internet?
completion: No. A working internet connection is required before the VPN tunnel can be established.

prompt: Can VPN connect before I have working internet?
completion: No. A working internet connection is required before the VPN tunnel can be established.

prompt: The only copy of my coursework is on a lab PC. Is that safe?
